name: theme-selected-by-config
description: A theme chosen through PROJECT OPTIONS (not a document header) and living in a subdirectory. The snapshot carries both the resolved themePath and the raw stored selection as a `pdf-theme` attribute — exactly the shape the app builds — because the regression this guards was the two disagreeing: the raw project-relative path overrode the resolved leaf name while `pdf-themesdir` was derived from that same path, so the engine resolved `branding/branding/…`, found nothing, and silently fell back to the built-in theme. A theme that never applies produces no error anywhere, so only a comparison against a themed reference catches it.
